name: research-to-plan
description: Turn research conclusions into a testable plan.

# Research to Plan Skill

Make each proposed action traceable to a conclusion or a clearly marked assumption.

## When to Use

Use when the requested output is an execution, fieldwork, product or further research plan.

## Prerequisites

Read the current dossier version, question states, evidence graph and both review verdicts when the job is consequential.

## How to Run

1. For each action, name the supporting conclusion or assumption and the evidence row or claim ID.
2. State owner, input, prerequisite, time/resource estimate, expected result and risk.
3. Define an observable acceptance check suited to the action. Software may use tests; fieldwork may use an interview protocol, sample coverage or document audit.
4. Specify stop and pivot conditions. When a high-impact question is unresolved, make the step conditional and say what evidence unlocks it.
5. Use `write_plan`, then assign `plan-review` the exact saved path and version. Record its verdict with `plan_verify`.

## Quick Reference

An action is ready when its assumptions, dependencies, verification and decision threshold are visible to the person who will execute it.

## Procedure

Review feasibility against known people, access, budget and time. If a decisive research claim changes, reopen any dependent step before calling the plan current.

## Pitfalls

Do not force a software test command onto a clinical survey or market study. Do not mark a recommendation final because the plan itself is detailed.

## Verification

Plan review should test whether the steps are executable and whether their checks would actually demonstrate the intended outcome.
